summary: KPY osk, an investment company, through its subsidiaries, offers infrastructure and private equity portfolio services in Finland. The company designs, builds, maintains, and operates telecommunications networks; installation and equipment sales; engages in leasing premises and related service activities; involves in owning and developing small and medium-sized domestic companies; and offers consultancy services in the areas of data and analytics, security, applications, and integrations, as well as occupational healthcare services. The company was founded in 1883 and is based in Kuopio, Finland.
